styleContract.lighting: soft stadium key plus cool rim
styleContract.scaleRule: Normalize standing height to the shared Gamecast character box while preserving player-specific build differences.
styleContract.uniform: Dallas white/silver/royal-blue; current jersey number required; no invented accessories.
styleContract.appearanceRule: Render complexion, hair, facial hair and visible facial traits only after visual inspection of the cited current official Dallas headshot. Never infer appearance from name.
styleContract.reuseRule: Base mesh/material rig is the authoritative neutral player asset from which action poses and animation clips are derived; do not redraw identity between actions.

players.name: Jonathan Mingo
players.neutralPose: balanced receiver stance with athletic knee bend, relaxed hands and shoulders prepared for release or blocking transition
productionNotes: Keep the 6-2/225 big-bodied receiver silhouette distinct from lighter WR rigs, with enough shoulder/hip range for release, route-run, contested-catch, run-after-catch and block clips.
No named signature celebration is assigned without verified repeatable footage.

players.name: Ryan Flournoy
players.neutralPose: balanced receiver stance with light forward load, relaxed hands and centered feet ready for release or route transition
productionNotes: Retain the 6-1/205 athletic receiver build across release, route-run, catch, contested-catch, run-after-catch, juke and block clips.
Use generic receiver/team celebration unless a repeatable player-specific signature is verified.

players.name: Caelen Carson
players.neutralPose: compact corner stance with low hips, light feet and hands ready for press, backpedal or break-on-ball transition
productionNotes: Keep the 6-0/198 corner silhouette compact and physical without inflating him to a safety build; preserve lateral range for man-cover, zone-break and turnover clips.
No named signature celebration is assigned without verification.

players.name: Ameer Speed
players.neutralPose: tall corner stance with long relaxed arms, balanced hips and light forward posture ready for press or backpedal
productionNotes: Retain the unusually tall 6-3/215 corner proportions and long limb silhouette through press-stance, backpedal, man-cover, tackle and interception clips.
No named signature celebration is assigned without verified repeatable footage.

players.name: Malik Hooker
players.neutralPose: strong veteran safety stance with square hips, balanced feet and relaxed hands ready for deep-zone or downhill trigger
productionNotes: Keep the 6-1/215 physical safety build stable across backpedal, deep-zone, break-on-ball, tackle, pass-breakup, interception and return clips.
Use generic defensive/team celebration unless a repeatable player-specific signature is verified; do not invent a named signature.

gamecastContract.phaseBoundary: This batch establishes reusable base assets/specifications only; action poses and signature sequences are not marked complete here.

notes: Current official Dallas roster/player pages were rechecked immediately before this batch for roster identity, jersey number, listed build and official headshot label.
Jonathan Mingo is #18 at 6-2/225; Ryan Flournoy is #19 at 6-1/205; Caelen Carson is #21 at 6-0/198; Ameer Speed is #23 at 6-3/215; Malik Hooker is #24 at 6-1/215 on current official Dallas pages.
Appearance traits are not encoded from names; the cited current official headshots remain the visual authority at render time.
No unverified named celebration was introduced.
No MLB or NHL integration files are part of this batch.
